C0104.title: BotSpot: A Hybrid Learning Framework to Uncover Bot Install Fraud in Mobile Advertising
C0104.summary: This study addresses bot install fraud in mobile advertising by proposing BotSpot, a hybrid learning framework for detecting fake installs. By analyzing advertiser feedback on whether installs are normal or bot-driven, the model identifies fraudulent activities that use automated scripts or bot accounts to simulate user installs, with relevant case studies demonstrated.
